text: I understand you're frustrated and want to speak with someone who can help with your specific situation. Since you don't want to use your existing payment method and don't have a gift card, and you need a different payment arrangement for the refund, I'll transfer you to a human agent who may have more flexibility to help you.
zh: 我理解您很沮丧，想和能帮助您解决具体问题的人说话。由于您不想使用现有的支付方式，也没有礼品卡，并且需要为退款安排不同的支付方式，我会将您转接给一位人类客服，他/她可能有更多的灵活性来帮助您。(#W1234567, #P7890123, 退款金额$50.00, customer@example.com)
